name: PERMAJU
recent: Permaju Industries Berhad 近期发生董事会变动，Koo Kien Yoon 辞任董事。公司披露一项重大诉讼，并签署一份谅解备忘录。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收环比增长63.7%但同比下滑54.7%，净亏损226.4万令吉。
notable: 董事会变动：Koo Kien Yoon 辞任董事。

risks: 公司涉及一项重大诉讼。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收276万令吉，环比增长63.7%，同比下滑54.7%；净亏损226.4万令吉，净亏损率82.0%，较上季度的283.1%有所收窄。

recent_en: Permaju Industries Berhad recently saw a boardroom change with the resignation of director Koo Kien Yoon. The company disclosed a material litigation and entered into a memorandum of understanding. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 63.7% QoQ but fell 54.7% YoY, with a net loss of MYR2.264 million.
notable_en: Boardroom change: Koo Kien Yoon resigned as director.
The company disclosed a material litigation.
The company entered into a memorandum of understanding.
risks_en: The company is involved in a material litigation.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR2.76 million, up 63.7% QoQ but down 54.7% YoY; net loss was MYR2.264 million with a net margin of -82.0%, narrowing from -283.1% in the previous quarter.
